intro: In the staffing sector a sick report often continues after the contract ends. As a self-insurer (eigenrisicodrager) under the Sickness Benefits Act (Ziektewet) you then carry the costs and the reintegration yourself, instead of UWV, the Dutch Employee Insurance Agency.

React2u Reflex knows that world. We guide sick temp workers quickly and purposefully towards suitable work, also after the contract has ended, and help you limit the inflow into the WGA, the Dutch benefit for partial or temporary incapacity for work.
